licenses.authority: California Department of Public Health (CDPH), Licensing & Certification

staffing.source: Payroll-Based Journal (PBJ), as published by CMS

provenance.note: Five-Star ratings and PBJ staffing apply to the CMS-certified universe only.
Linked to the CMS record by exact CCN.

inspection_summary.window_note: CMS publishes about the three most recent standard surveys plus complaint and infection-control inspections from the prior three years. Older findings leave the dataset; their absence is not evidence they never happened.

state_action_summary.note: California CDPH state citations and administrative penalties, 1997 to early 2024 (archived dataset). Separate from federal CMS deficiencies.

cms-f0580.title: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

cms-f0755.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.

cms-f0600.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
cms-f0600.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0684.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
cms-f0684.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0609.title: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
cms-f0609.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-k0222.title: Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.

cms-k0223.title: Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.

cms-k0353.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.

cms-k0521.title: Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.

cms-k0712.title: Have simulated fire drills held at unexpected times.

cms-k0918.title: Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
cms-k0918.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0920.title: Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.
cms-k0920.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0511.title: Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.

cms-e0025.title: Create arrangements with other facilities to receive patients.

cms-f0605.title: Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
cms-f0605.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0638.title: Assure that each resident’s assessment is updated at least once every 3 months.
cms-f0638.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0656.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
cms-f0656.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0689.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
cms-f0689.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0726.title: Ensure that nurses and nurse aides have the appropriate competencies to care for every resident in a way that maximizes each resident's well being.

cms-f0759.title: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

cms-f0761.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

cms-f0803.title: Ensure menus must meet the nutritional needs of residents, be prepared in advance, be followed, be updated, be reviewed by dietician, and meet the needs of the resident.

cms-f0812.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

cms-f0550.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

cms-f0552.title: Ensure that residents are fully informed and understand their health status, care and treatments.

cms-f0558.title: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident.

cms-f0583.title: Keep residents' personal and medical records private and confidential.

cms-f0584.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

cms-f0604.title: Ensure that each resident is free from the use of physical restraints, unless needed for medical treatment.
cms-f0604.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0676.title: Ensure residents do not lose the ability to perform activities of daily living unless there is a medical reason.
cms-f0676.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0685.title: Assist a resident in gaining access to vision and hearing services.
cms-f0685.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0688.title: Provide appropriate care for a resident to maintain and/or improve range of motion (ROM), limited ROM and/or mobility, unless a decline is for a medical reason.
cms-f0688.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0699.title: Provide care or services that was trauma informed and/or culturally competent.
cms-f0699.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0730.title: Observe each nurse aide's job performance and give regular training.

cms-f0760.title: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

cms-f0842.title: Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
cms-f0842.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0880.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

cms-f0881.title: Implement a program that monitors antibiotic use.

cms-f0908.title: Keep all essential equipment working safely.

cms-k0363.title: Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.

cms-k0211.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.

cms-k0321.title: Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.

cms-k0351.title: Install an approved automatic sprinkler system.

cms-k0923.title: Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.
cms-k0923.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-e0018.title: Establish procedures for tracking staff and patients during an emergency.

cms-e0035.title: Provide family notifications of emergency plan.

cms-e0036.title: Establish emergency prep training and testing.

cms-f0945.title: Include as part of its infection prevention and control program, mandatory training that includes written standards, policies, and procedures for the program.

cms-f0641.title: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.
cms-f0641.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0645.title: PASARR screening for Mental disorders or Intellectual Disabilities
cms-f0645.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0695.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
cms-f0695.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0742.title: Provide the appropriate treatment and services to a resident who displays or is diagnosed with mental disorder or psychosocial adjustment difficulty, or who has a history of trauma and/or post-traumatic stress disorder.
cms-f0742.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0887.title: Educate residents and staff on COVID-19 vaccination, offer the COVID-19 vaccine to eligible residents and staff after education, and properly document each resident and staff member's vaccination status.

cms-f0911.title: Ensure resident rooms hold no more than 4 residents; for new construction after November 28, 2016, rooms hold no more than 2 residents.

cms-f0912.title: Provide rooms that are at least 80 square feet per resident in multiple rooms and 100 square feet for single resident rooms.

cms-f0728.title: Ensure that nurse aides who have worked more than 4 months, are trained and competent; and nurse aides who have worked less than 4 months are enrolled in appropriate training.

cms-f0940.title: Develop, implement, and/or maintain an effective training program for all new and existing staff members.

cms-f0947.title: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

cms-f0867.title: Set up an ongoing quality assessment and assurance group to review quality deficiencies  and develop corrective plans of action.

cms-f0776.title: Provide timely, approved x-ray services, or have an agreement with an approved provider to obtain them.

cms-f0678.title: Provide basic life support, including CPR, prior to the arrival of emergency medical personnel , subject to physician orders and the resident’s advance directives.
cms-f0678.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0610.title: Respond appropriately to all alleged violations.
cms-f0610.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-k0345.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.

cms-f0606.title: Not hire anyone with a finding of abuse, neglect, exploitation, or theft.
cms-f0606.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0757.title: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.

cms-f0732.title: Post nurse staffing information every day.

cms-f0607.title: Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.
cms-f0607.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies
